subtitle: 杰克和朱迪登场

paragraphs.en: While we may still be months out from pulling off gigs in our local game stores, WeirdCo keeps cooking and revealing new cards for their highly anticipated Cyberpunk Trading Card Game .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然距离我们能在本地游戏店里完成委托可能还要等上几个月，WeirdCo仍在不断制作并揭晓备受期待的《赛博朋克2077》集换式卡牌游戏新卡。

paragraphs.en: This card game, which blew up on Kickstarter earlier this year , features cards based on places and beloved characters from the anime and the CD Projekt Red RPG Cyberpunk 2077 .
paragraphs.cn: 这款卡牌游戏今年早些时候在Kickstarter上爆火，收录了以动画和CDPR的RPG《赛博朋克2077》中的地点及深受喜爱的角色为原型的卡牌。

paragraphs.en: A bunch of cards have already been shown and can be found over on the Cyberpunk TCG website , but IGN has a couple of brand-new cards to reveal that showcase new Legend and Unit cards in both their base and fancy Iconic versions.
paragraphs.cn: 许多卡牌已公开，可在Cyberpunk TCG官网查看；不过IGN还有两张全新卡牌待揭晓，展示了新Legend和Unit卡牌的基础版及华丽的Iconic版。

paragraphs.en: Good ol’ Jackie Wells, your best bud from Cyberpunk 2077, is back with a brand new Legend with Jackie Wells - Mama’s Favorite. This time in green Leader with a RAM value of 2, Jackie’s got a high attack power of 8, making him easy to break through the 10 power threshold to steal additional gigs when he attacks, thanks to his “Go Solo” ability. Cyberware like “Sandevistan” would be a perfect choice for this since it would help keep Jackie safe by readying (untapping) him at the end of your turn!
paragraphs.cn: 老朋友杰克·威尔斯——你在《赛博朋克2077》中的挚友——将以全新的Legend卡「杰克·威尔斯——妈妈的最爱」回归。这次他是一张绿色Leader卡，RAM值为2，攻击力高达8；凭借「Go Solo」能力，他攻击时很容易突破10点力量门槛，抢走额外委托。像「Sandevistan」这样的义体会是绝佳搭配，因为它能在你的回合结束时令杰克重置（解除横置），帮助他保持安全！

paragraphs.en: The real power of this new Legend doesn’t come from how hard he hits, though. Just like how Jackie looks out for V in the game, Jackie Welles: Mama’s Favorite, helps keep your other units safe. By spending 1 Eddy when a unit would be defeated, you can instead have Jackie get defeated instead and removed from the game. Great for keeping an important unit or one you’ve loaded up with gear, covered, and out of harm's way. At least against one fatal blow.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这张新Legend的真正威力并不在于他打得多狠。就像游戏中杰克会照看V一样，「杰克·威尔斯：妈妈的最爱」也能保护你的其他单位。一个单位将被击败时，支付1点Eddy，就可改为让杰克被击败并移出游戏。它很适合保护关键单位或你已装备满配的单位，让它们免受伤害——至少能挡下一次致命一击。

paragraphs.en: Judy Alvarez: Nothing to Doubt looks to be positioning itself as a powerhouse in the first set. With a cost of 6 alongside a solid 6 power, her special ability allows you to tap her and pay a single Eddy to play the top card of your deck or add it to your hand, which is the real star. This will be the perfect card for decks running high-value cards and getting them out easily.
paragraphs.cn: 「朱迪：毋庸置疑」看来有望成为首弹中的强力卡牌。她的费用为6，力量也有扎实的6点；真正的亮点是她的特殊能力：横置她并支付1点Eddy，即可打出牌库顶牌，或将该牌加入手牌。这会是采用高价值卡牌、并希望轻松将其打出的卡组的理想选择。

paragraphs.en: Before you get too excited, though, the aspect of Judy that may make you pump your brakes is her 5-blue Ram requirement. As of the time of writing, there are no blue Legends that provide 3x Blue RAM to your pool, meaning Judy will only be playable if you are running a mono-blue Cyberpunk deck, which will take out some flexibility. With such a strong ability, too, she will need some blockers out to take some hits for her, because once she comes out, it’s a safe bet that she will jump to the top of your opponent’s hit list. Still, a really solid card!
paragraphs.cn: 不过先别太兴奋，朱迪有一点可能会让你踩刹车：她需要5个蓝色RAM。截至撰稿时，尚无蓝色Legend能向你的资源池提供3个蓝色RAM，这意味着只有使用纯蓝赛博朋克卡组时才能打出朱迪，牺牲了一部分灵活性。此外，她的能力如此强大，场上还得有些阻挡者替她挨打；因为她一登场，几乎肯定会跃升为对手的头号集火目标。不过，她依然是一张相当扎实的卡！

opus_summary: WeirdCo公布《赛博朋克2077》TCG的两张新卡：杰克·威尔斯可替队友承受致命一击；朱迪可调度高价值卡牌，却受5个蓝色RAM要求限制。
